-74.92470,39.88470.name: South Jersey Fertility Center
-74.92470,39.88470.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Peter G. Van Deerlin, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-1.83301,50.72404.name: BEC Treatment Centre
-1.83301,50.72404.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-73.75497,42.65117.name: Albany Medical College
-73.75497,42.65117.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Albany Med Health Care System. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-98.92787,19.27320.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: www.institutovida.com. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

77.49366,23.25454.name: National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD)
77.49366,23.25454.desc: A BSL4 animal laboratory, operational. Run by Indian Council of Agricultural Research. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on animal health. Operational or announced: 2000. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-89.40120,43.07310.name: Wisconsin National Primate Research Center
-89.40120,43.07310.desc: One of seven federally funded US primate centres, holding several thousand monkeys. Primates are covered by the Animal Welfare Act, so numbers, procedures and inspection findings are public here in a way they are not for rodents — the difference is statutory, not practical.

-89.40120,43.07310.name: Wisconsin Cryobank / amphibian biobanking
-89.40120,43.07310.desc: Cryopreservation of amphibian sperm and cell lines, for the taxon losing species fastest. Amphibians are dying out faster than they are being sampled, and whatever is banked now is the entire set of options anyone will have later.

-89.40120,43.07310.name: URUS Group
-89.40120,43.07310.desc: A holding company that brings several cattle breeding and reproduction brands under one owner, including Alta Genetics, GENEX and an embryo transfer business, with operations across North America, Latin America and beyond. Consolidation in this facet is quieter than in seed and has had far less attention, but the shape is the same: a farmer choosing between what look like competing brands of bull semen, embryo services and herd management software may be choosing among subsidiaries of one group.

-0.08630,51.50330.name: Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority
-0.08630,51.50330.desc: Licenses every fertility clinic and every piece of human embryo research in the United Kingdom, and publishes what it finds clinic by clinic. It is the only regulator in the world doing all three, which is why the UK is the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated. Its own published statements set out the limits of that power more plainly than most regulators do. Donor-conceived people may request non-identifying information at 16 and the donor's full name, date of birth and last known address at 18, for donations made after March 2005; anonymous donation is not permitted. A licensed clinic may use one donor for at most ten families. Imported sperm must respect that limit inside the UK, but the limit does not apply in the country the donor donated in, so a child may have many more half-siblings abroad. Donation outside a licensed clinic falls entirely outside its remit, with no control on how often a donor is used, and it notes some unregulated donors have led to more than 200 children in the UK. And the law prevents it telling parents who the donor is even when it knows: only the donor-conceived person may apply, and only at 18.

-77.03500,38.90200.name: State departments of agriculture — the body that actually inspects
-77.03500,38.90200.state: Washington DC — NASDA, 4350 North Fairfax Drive
-77.03500,38.90200.desc: Almost every enforceable complaint about a crop in the United States is handled by a state department of agriculture rather than by a federal agency. They employ the inspectors, they can enter a field, and they issue the penalties. Sending a report to Washington first is the commonest reason an account of harm goes nowhere.
